account.title: Set up Hermes account
account.description: Sign in once to import parcels from your Hermes account. Log in with your account **username**, not your email address. Your password is never stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Hermes
reauth_confirm.description: Hermes no longer accepts the saved login for **{username}**. Enter the password again.

error.invalid_auth: The username or password was not accepted.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Hermes. Try again later.
error.update_required: Hermes refused this integration's app access. The integration needs an update — wait for a new release; logging in again will not help.

data_description.add: Enter a Hermes tracking code to start tracking it. You find it on the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Hermes tracking code.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Hermes tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Hermes tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Hermes tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
